description: This Java source file defines a class named MessageCommandSignalMapper, which maps MessageCommand objects to signals by extracting relevant information such as subject, status code, and headers. It extends an abstract mapper class and overrides specific extraction methods.

classes.name: MessageCommandSignalMapper
classes.description: A final class that maps MessageCommand messages to protocol signals by extracting subject, status code, and message headers.

methods.name: extractSubject
methods.description: Extracts the subject string from the given MessageCommand.

methods.name: extractStatusCode
methods.description: Extracts the status code from the message within the MessageCommand, returning an Optional<HttpStatusCode>.

methods.name: extractMessageHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the headers from the message contained in the MessageCommand.
